sources.entry: Clay - Automates outreach and contact workflows (cold email, LinkedIn DMs) based on buyer personas. #freemium

summary.name: Clay
summary.one_liner: Clay is a go-to-market (GTM) platform for finding and enriching B2B contact and account data, running AI agent workflows, and building outbound sales plays.
use_cases: Enriching prospect and account data for outbound sales
Scoring and routing inbound or target leads to reps
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Clay as infrastructure for getting data from a marketplace of 200+ data and AI vendors under one contract, combining first- and third-party data and creating intent signals. It offers AI agents (including Claygent) that research accounts, score them, and write personalized outreach using business context. Workflows are built on a visual canvas using clicks, code, or chat, and can be reused across runs. Plays can trigger emails, ads and other actions through integrations with existing GTM tools.
notable: Data marketplace with 200+ data and AI vendors under one contract
Claygent AI agents for research, scoring and outreach
Visual canvas for building and troubleshooting GTM plays
Integrations with existing GTM tools such as Salesforce
caveats: Page is mostly customer testimonials and case-study claims; no pricing tiers or plan details are stated
Listing tags it as freemium, but the page itself does not detail free versus paid plans
